description: The frozen descriptor-v2 semantic vocabulary (RT-09): the closed value sets for the structured §14.8 columns, collected as the distinct values actually in use across every committed spec/descriptors/*.json transition row and frozen here as part of the descriptor format spec (gap note G45, spec/schemas/ops/README.md). conformance/run.py rejects any descriptor column entry outside these sets, and events must additionally match the grammar ^[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z0-9_-]+$ (machine-prefixed dotted event type). Extending a column is a spec change to this file, never an in-place free string — semantic erasure to arbitrary nonempty prose fails closed.
